# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/world_tension.mjs, docs/specs/03_gameplay/05_world_tension_and_endings.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Effects of the Gathering Dark, the War of the Last Crowns, the endings and the world tick. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> (E1).
zin_world_add_gathering_dark = {
	# Argument zin_arg_value (E1): the change. Gains are scaled by zin_gathering_dark_rate and damped from 75 and 50; losses are not.
	# Clamps to 0 to 100, stores the change in zin_gd_last_change and adds it to the month's total, and fires each tier's news on first entry.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_v = zin_arg_value }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_value
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_v > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark_rate > 0 } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gd_v = global.zin_gathering_dark_rate }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gd_v = constant:zin_world.damp_75 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gd_v = constant:zin_world.damp_50 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_last_change = zin_gd_v }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_gd_month_change = zin_gd_v }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark = zin_gd_v }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_2_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_2_seen
		random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.10 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_3_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_3_seen
		random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.11 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_4_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_gd_tier_4_seen
		random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.12 } }
	}
}
zin_world_monthly_sources = {
	# Step 3: the monthly sources of the Gathering Dark (spec, "Monthly sources"). Each source's value is kept in global.zin_gd_src_<key> for the tooltip;
	# the gains go through zin_world_add_gathering_dark together (scaled), then the losses (not scaled), each loss stopping at its floor.
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_court = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_council = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_envoys = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_wars = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dead_march = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_glo = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_league = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_peace = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_age_turns = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AEN }
		AEN = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_court = constant:zin_world.src_court_75 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_court = constant:zin_world.src_court_50 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_council_influence value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned }
					set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_council = constant:zin_world.src_council_crowned }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_council = constant:zin_world.src_council }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_aenor_lost_cause value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_league = constant:zin_world.src_league }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PUV }
		PUV = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south = constant:zin_world.src_south_75 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south = constant:zin_world.src_south_50 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ZOL }
		ZOL = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_mistake_power value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north = constant:zin_world.src_north_70 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_mistake_power value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north = constant:zin_world.src_north_40 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_footholds = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_wars = 0 }
	every_country = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_footholds = zin_footholds }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_major = yes
				has_war = yes
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_wars = constant:zin_world.src_wars_each }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_gd_footholds value = 300 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_envoys = constant:zin_world.src_envoys_300 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_gd_footholds value = 150 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_envoys = constant:zin_world.src_envoys_150 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_wars = zin_gd_wars }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_dead = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_dominion = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					controller = { zin_is_zol = yes }
					NOT = { is_core_of = ZOL }
				}
				AND = {
					controller = {
						OR = {
							zin_is_volgan = yes
							is_subject_of = PUV
						}
					}
					NOT = { is_core_of = PUV }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { controller = { zin_is_zol = yes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_dead = constant:zin_world.src_dead_march_each }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_dominion = constant:zin_world.src_dominion_march_each }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dead_march = zin_gd_dead }
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march = zin_gd_dominion }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_gd_src_wars max = constant:zin_world.src_wars_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_gd_src_dead_march max = constant:zin_world.src_dead_march_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march max = constant:zin_world.src_dominion_march_max }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 }
				check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 4 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_glo = constant:zin_world.src_glo }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_world_peace_holds = yes
			check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 5 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_peace = constant:zin_world.src_peace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached
			check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_age_turns = constant:zin_world.src_age_turns }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_court > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_court }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_court }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_council > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_council }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_council }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_south }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_south }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_north }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_north }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_envoys > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_envoys }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_envoys }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_wars > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_wars }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_wars }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dead_march > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_dead_march }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_dead_march }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_dominion_march }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_glo > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_glo }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_glo }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_league > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_league }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_league }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_peace > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_peace }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_peace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_age_turns > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gain = global.zin_gd_src_age_turns }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_loss = global.zin_gd_src_age_turns }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gain > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_gd_gain }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_loss < 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_before = global.zin_gathering_dark }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_gd_loss }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_age_turns < 0 }
				check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 10 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_peace < 0 }
				check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 5 }
				check_variable = { zin_gd_before > 4.999 }
			}
			set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark = 5 }
		}
	}
}
zin_world_one_time_values = {
	# Step 2: the one-time "world" values, applied once per flag the first month the tick sees it (zin_gd_done_<flag>).
	if = {

			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_gd_done_zin_golden_king_dead }

zin_world_pick_threat_country = {
	# The country behind the largest active source: Volgan for the south, Zol for the north, Aenor for the court, council and envoys; else the runner.
	clear_global_event_target = zin_world_threat_country
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_court = global.zin_gd_src_court }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_court = global.zin_gd_src_council }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gd_court = global.zin_gd_src_envoys }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = PUV
			check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south < global.zin_gd_src_north } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_south < zin_gd_court } }
		}
		PUV = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_threat_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = ZOL
			check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_src_north < zin_gd_court } }
		}
		ZOL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_threat_country }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AEN }
		AEN = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_threat_country }
	}
	else = {
		save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_threat_country
	}
}
zin_world_sync_engine_tension = {
	# Step 4 (spec, "Engine tension follows the meter"): the engine's world tension follows (zin_gathering_dark - 10) / 100.
	# A rise of engine tension of more than 0.02 since last month (engine wars, annexations) adds 50 percent of it to the meter as Wars of the Living,
	# unless the meter fell this month; then named threat closes the gap below the target in up to 3 steps. Run in a country scope.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_threat = threat }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_world_last_threat }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_rise = zin_gd_threat }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_rise = global.zin_world_last_threat }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_gd_rise > 0.02 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_gd_month_change < 0 } }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gd_rise = constant:zin_world.engine_rise_points }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_gd_rise }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		}
	}
	zin_world_pick_threat_country = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = global.zin_gathering_dark }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = constant:zin_world.engine_offset }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = 100 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = threat }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_threat_country }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.1 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 10 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.05 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 5 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.02 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 2 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = global.zin_gathering_dark }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = constant:zin_world.engine_offset }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = 100 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = threat }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_threat_country }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.1 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 10 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.05 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 5 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.02 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 2 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = global.zin_gathering_dark }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = constant:zin_world.engine_offset }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = 100 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_gd_gap = threat }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_threat_country }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.1 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 10 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.05 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 5 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gd_gap > 0.02 } }
			event_target:zin_world_threat_country = { add_named_threat = { threat = 2 name = zin_world_threat_gathering_dark } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_world_last_threat = threat }
}
zin_world_start_last_crowns = {
	# Sets zin_war_of_last_crowns once and tells every country (zin_world.20). It forces no war: every front is its owner's.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns } }
		set_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		log = "ZIN world: the War of the Last Crowns begins"
		random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.20 } }
	}
}
zin_world_check_last_crowns = {
	# Spec, "The War of the Last Crowns": HISTORICAL on its date; PLAUSIBLE on the first of the meter at 65 after its date, a dark war, or
	# the latest date; FREE on the first two. Outside HISTORICAL the first front of the war that comes on its own sets the flag piecemeal (B18 D3).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns } }
		if = {
			limit = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { zin_world_date_last_crowns = yes }
				zin_world_start_last_crowns = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						zin_world_date_plausible_meter = yes
						check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 65 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					zin_world_dark_war = yes
					AND = {
						zin_rules_is_free = no
						zin_world_date_plausible_latest = yes
					}
				}
			}
			zin_world_start_last_crowns = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = zin_leren_withdrawal
					has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing
					has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
					has_global_flag = zin_mirolon_fallen
					has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
					has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_war_piecemeal
			zin_world_start_last_crowns = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_world_tension_tick = {
	# Steps 1 to 6 of the month.
	set_variable = { global.zin_gd_month_change = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_world_dead_k = 0 }
	every_country = { add_to_variable = { global.zin_world_dead_k = casualties_k } }
	zin_world_one_time_values = yes
	zin_world_monthly_sources = yes
	zin_world_sync_engine_tension = yes
	zin_world_check_last_crowns = yes
}
zin_world_reach_ending = {
	# Argument zin_arg_ending (E1): 1 lost_cause, 2 children_of_volgan, 3 ashen_throne, 4 golden_court, 5 western_crown, 6 strait_master, 7 eastern_king, 8 unfinished.
	# Exactly one ending per game: the first call sets zin_ending_reached, global.zin_world_ending and the ending's flag, reveals Afrit first when the
	# Ashen Throne comes while the secret is kept, sends the ending's news to every country (its option gives the spirit to the holder) and starts
	# the epilogue (zin_ending_start_epilogue, which fires the Chronicle). Every later call does nothing.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_end = zin_arg_ending }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_ending
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			check_variable = { zin_end > 0 }
			check_variable = { zin_end < 9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_end = 3 }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_voluntary = 0 }
			zin_afrit_reveal = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_ending_reached
		set_variable = { global.zin_world_ending = zin_end }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 1 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_lost_cause
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lost_cause_with_eindil } }
				set_global_flag = zin_lost_cause_with_eindil
			}
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.100 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 2 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_children_of_volgan
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.101 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 3 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_ashen_throne
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.102 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 4 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_golden_court
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.103 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 5 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_western_crown
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.104 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 6 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_strait_master
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.105 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 7 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_eastern_king
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.106 days = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_end = 8 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_unfinished
			random_country = { news_event = { id = zin_world.107 days = 1 } }
		}
		log = "ZIN world: ending [?global.zin_world_ending|0] reached"
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = zin_end }
		zin_ending_start_epilogue = yes
	}
}
zin_world_check_endings = {
	# Step 7, and the Aenor spec's call at the coronation. Canon endings any month, in order (spec: the order decides a tie); the proposed outcomes
	# once, when the judgement opens (zin_world_judgement_open); the Age Unfinished on its date.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 1 }
			zin_world_reach_ending = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				zin_world_date_children = yes
				zin_volgan_children_ready = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 2 }
			zin_world_reach_ending = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_ashen_throne_ready = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 3 }
			zin_world_reach_ending = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_judged }
				zin_world_judgement_open = yes
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_world_judged
			log = "ZIN world: the proposed outcomes are judged"
			if = {
				limit = { zin_world_golden_court_holds = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 4 }
				zin_world_reach_ending = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { zin_world_western_crown_holds = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 5 }
				zin_world_reach_ending = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { zin_world_strait_master_holds = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 6 }
				zin_world_reach_ending = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { zin_world_eastern_king_holds = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 7 }
				zin_world_reach_ending = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				zin_world_date_judgement = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_judgement_deferred }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_judged }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_world_judgement_deferred
			log = "ZIN world: the judgement of the age waits, for the heir is still on his road"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
				zin_world_date_unfinished = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ending = 8 }
			zin_world_reach_ending = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_world_schedule_tick = {
	# Picks the runner of the next month (the first country of data/world_tension.json "runners" that exists, else the realm with the most
	# states, else any) and schedules zin_world.1 there in 30 days. The runner carries the country flag zin_world_runner, which on_annex reads.
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_runner }
		event_target:zin_world_runner = { clr_country_flag = zin_world_runner }
	}
	clear_global_event_target = zin_world_runner
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = AEN }
		AEN = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = LER }
		LER = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CLD }
		CLD = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PUV }
		PUV = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GOL }
		GOL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GAA }
		GAA = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SEL }
		SEL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = WOR }
		WOR = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_best = 0 }
		every_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_gd_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gd_best = num_of_controlled_states }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_runner }
		event_target:zin_world_runner = {
			set_country_flag = zin_world_runner
			country_event = { id = zin_world.1 days = 30 }
		}
	}
}
zin_world_tick = {
	# The world tick (spec, "The world tick"): once a month on the runner; the timed flag zin_world_tick_month keeps a second chain from running twice.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_world_tick_month } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = zin_world_tick_month value = 1 days = 25 }
		zin_world_tension_tick = yes
		zin_world_check_endings = yes
		zin_path_tick = yes
		zin_story_tick = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			zin_ui_refresh = yes
		}
		zin_world_schedule_tick = yes
	}
}
